entities.summary: Hazel Poa Koon Koon is a Singaporean politician and businesswoman. A member of the opposition Progress Singapore Party (PSP), Poa served as Secretary-General of the PSP from 2024 to 2025 and as a Non-Constituency Member of Parliament (NCMP) between 2020 to 2025.
